theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Prop) (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P) (r s c lam : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (T x).starProjection) μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Q x) → 0 < r → s ≤ r → (∀ y ∈ F, dist y ξ ≤ r) → (∀ y ∈ F, ∫⁻ x in closedBall y (2 * r), ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (T x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ m) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c) → (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ m * c) < ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ (closedBall ξ s) → ∃ x₀ ∈ closedBall ξ s, Q x₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ F, ‖(y - x₀) - (T x₀).starProjection (y - x₀)‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam
